newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - crude pulls products lower.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - crude pulls products lower.

text.p: NWE oil products slid weaker sucumming to crude's pull on Tuesday.
Gasoline slumped $10-12 on Tuesday as support from strike-related short covering and transatlantic arb offtake gave way.
Naphtha continued to drift lower across Europe stayed thin.
Gas oil slid $2.50 on futures but premiums were stable to slightly lower on flat demand. Traders explored an arb to the U.S. and Asia.

Fuel oil was knocked lower by crude with cargoes and barges losing ground. However, buying interest was stronger because of the weaker prices. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7456 (c) Reuters Limited 1996
